family: fam11 = LARGE-WEIGHT probe at the best (margin-0) hive shapes
target: TIER0 (h*_1 = 0 and h*_d > 0) / JACKPOT (h*_d > h*_1) / NEG (negative monomial coefficient of the stretched LR polynomial)
statistic: margin := h*_1 - h*_d = B - (d+1), B = #lattice points on the relative boundary of Q; JACKPOT <=> margin < 0
sampling: structured weight ladders (exhaustive within each ladder's parameter list) + a sampled random large-weight pool

instrument.cap: 1e6 on the sharded runs (CAP_EXCEEDED = SKIP, never a verdict); struct_small.jsonl ran at the default 1e12

arms.C_coladd: lam += (t^r), nu += (t^r): skew shape translated, so P must be IDENTICAL -- instrument audit at large weight
arms.D_stretch: staircase nu with step s = 1..55 at r = 5,6,7
arms.F_plateau: repeated parts / spike+flat-tail nu, engineered to force implicit equalities (the only regime not closed by Theorem 1)
arms.E_random: sampled random triples, r in {5,6}, |nu| in {40,60,90,130,190,280,400}; 3640 triples launched in 10 shards, INCOMPLETE at report time (E_*.jsonl absent)

weight_trend.dilation: margin(k) = B_Q(k) - (d+1) with B_Q(k) = P(k) - (-1)^d P(-k), a degree-(d-1) polynomial with positive leading coefficient. For the refuter margin(k) = k^3 + 4k - 5, measured exactly as 0, 11, 34, 75, 140, 235, 366 for k = 1..7. DIVERGES: dilation strictly worsens the margin for every hive polytope of dim >= 2.
weight_trend.toprow_inflation: margin EXACTLY 0 and (d,c,h*) = (4,5,(1,0,1,0,0)) unchanged for every t up to |nu| = 5015. SATURATES: never improves, never worsens.
weight_trend.coladd_control: P identical for all t (instrument audit passed at |nu| = 215).
weight_trend.staircase_stretch: margin exactly 0 with c = d+1 at d = 3 (r=5), d = 4 (r=6), d = 5 (r=7) for every step measured.
weight_trend.verdict: no weight axis moves the margin below 0; the best shapes sit pinned at B = d+1, one lattice point above the tier-0 requirement B = d.

caveats: A null census is NOT evidence for the KTT conjecture.
CAP_EXCEEDED records (244) are skips: fat large-weight polytopes were not decided.
Arm E (3640 sampled large-weight triples) was still running when this manifest was written; its shards are E_*.batch / E_*.jsonl in this directory.
nonlattice certification was run only on r=5 records (exact vertex enumeration); r=6/7 non-latticeness was not certified here.
